online.title: Online play
online.subtitle: Create a Steam lobby, browse open tables or join a friend.
online.steam_hint: Online play tunnelled through Steam Networking Sockets with relay support.
online.how_to_body: The host's computer runs the rules engine and is authoritative for every move. Clients send intended moves; the host validates them and sends back the resulting state. Hidden information (hands, roles, secret objectives) is sent only to its owner. Connections use Steam Networking Sockets, so relay is available when a direct connection is impossible.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: What Game Hub is, how it is built and what it stores.
about.tagline: A desktop hub for thirteen board games, built with Godot {version}.
about.what_body: Game Hub bundles thirteen board and card games behind one shell. Every game runs on its own deterministic rules engine, so a match can be played hotseat on one computer, against the built-in AI, or online through a Steam lobby where the host validates every move.
about.scope_1: Thirteen games listed, each with its own rules engine, table screen and bot.
about.scope_2: Ten interface languages with automatic English fallback and coverage reporting.
about.scope_3: Online play over Steam Networking Sockets (host-authoritative, relay capable).
about.scope_4: Nothing is collected or sent anywhere except the moves other players need to see.
about.tech_steam: GodotSteam GDExtension, Steamworks App ID 480 (Spacewar, test app)
about.tech_fonts: System fonts with fallback for CJK, procedural audio (no audio files)
about.tech_art: Original vector artwork generated for this project
about.legal_1: Game Hub is an independent implementation of public game rules. It ships no copyrighted board art, card scans or rulebook text from any publisher.
about.legal_2: Game names are used only to describe the rules that are implemented. All trademarks belong to their owners.
about.legal_3: Steam integration uses App ID 480, Valve's public test application, for development and verification.
